findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - Run the repository's full test suite after this change.
The new default makes test setup that replaces `workers = "split"` or `"codex"` with Claude a no-op. Its subsequent Git commit fails because there is nothing to commit; the helper raises on a nonzero exit. Examples are `tests/test_aha_templates.py:35-38` and `tests/test_services_guide.py:35-44`. The same setup appears in `tests/test_adoption_shared_input_checks.py`, `test_after_demo_guide.py`, `test_agent_ready_guide.py`, `test_agents_skill.py`, `test_deployment_requires_an_explicit_request.py`, `test_deploy_setup_guide.py`, `test_journey_guide.py`, `test_mcp_guide.py`, `test_mcp_resources_guide.py`, `test_prodgap_guide.py`, `test_request_log_guide.py`, `test_reviews_receive_done_when_proof.py`, `test_spec_rules.py` and `test_workers_fix_findings_until_close_holds.py`. Separately, `tests/test_workers_delegate_independent_work.py:75-95` no longer switches to Codex, and `tests/test_fix_reviews_always_run_on_codex_so_a_team_wi.py:67-81` no longer selects Claude-only. The full suite specified in `forge.toml:6` therefore cannot pass unchanged.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - A teammate clones a two-tool repo, has both CLIs installed, and runs `forge doctor` before working, but one CLI is not signed in or Codex has not trusted the project.
The generated settings leave `tools` at `both` and set `workers` to `claude`. In `src/forge/doctor.py:349-370`, that makes `on_codex` false and skips both the Codex sign-in check and the Claude check reserved for `tools = "claude"`. The same condition downgrades missing Codex trust to a note at `doctor.py:479-482,513-519`. Yet `src/forge/review.py:842-846` still selects installed Codex for reviews, and `src/forge/worker.py:473-480` requires its trust for a Codex read. Doctor can consequently exit successfully before a build, read, or review fails for a setup problem it did not report as a failure.
Adds work: check the readiness of both used tools in doctor; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 2

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - A coordinator consults the shipped guide to explain which tool builds a newly initialized repo.
The standard says, "Replacing behaviour deletes the old path, its tests and its docs in the same change." Although this section now says Claude is the default, `src/forge/templates/skill.md:1933-1936` still says init writes split workers and new repos send ordinary work to Codex; the changed `.claude` and `.codex` copies contain the same claim. In addition, `docs/guide.md:12` says Codex reads plans for new repos even when a Codex coordinator's first read uses Claude. The shipped instructions therefore give contradictory answers about the new routing.
findings.title: Standard: Delete before adding
